name: Prayling
ability: Blindsight (its own: every move it uses hits) / Sniper (hidden)
look: a tiny leaf-green baby mantis with no eyes, a wide triangular head, leafy feelers, little forelegs folded as if praying, four thin legs and a fan of leaves for a tail
entry: It is born without eyes, yet it never misses. It feels the faintest stir of air through its leafy feelers and knows exactly where its prey is, then holds its little forelegs together and waits.
how: Wild: common in jungles, uncommon in flower forests, meadows and forests.
